title: Milestone 2026.04.57 Operational Retrospective
wall_time_delta_note: Conductor cycle grew from 11 experiments (143 min, .56) to 14 experiments (235 min, .57) — +3 more targeted experiments including the 19.68-min RETRO-033 confirmation trial. Per-experiment average IMPROVED (235/14=16.8 min/exp on wall-clock but raw compute avg dominated by Exp 742; 13 of 14 experiments completed in <2 min). Full milestone comparison unavailable (conductor-log.md absent). If legacy re-execution occurred outside cycle, full milestone estimate: 3744 - 264 (manifest partial) + 84 (new exps) = ~3564 min (-180 min vs .56 baseline). This file is the conductor-cycle retro; augmented full-milestone retro requires timing data from external queue.

slowest_5.title: RETRO-033 Confirmation Trial: seed 999
slowest_5.root_cause: First appearance. Live GPU inference — 196 questions at batch_size=8. 19.68 min is expected compute time for full 200q batched inference on Qwen3.5-0.8B. No optimization applicable — this is the minimum time for a valid 200q trial. Exp 742 is the LAST execution of this class: RETRO-033 definitively closed by two independent 200q trials (seed=218 and seed=999 both +0.00510). No future recurrence expected.

slowest_5.title: Privacy Filter KAN v2 — Teacher-Free PII Detection
slowest_5.root_cause: First appearance. KAN training on 1600 examples (800 benign + 800 PII) with 3-dataset holdout evaluation. 1.71 min is expected training time. AUROC=1.0 on 2/3 holdout sets, 0.985 in-distribution. Gate passed. Weights saved. No optimization needed — this is correct compute budget for the task.

slowest_5.title: CoCoA Tier 0f — Training-Free Inter-Layer Disagreement Detector
slowest_5.root_cause: First appearance. Evaluated 132 questions with Qwen3.5-0.8B hidden-state probing across 5 layers. Effective AUC=0.8118 (score direction inverted). 0.35 min is expected for 132-question hidden-state extraction. No optimization needed.

slowest_5.title: D-Wave Neal SamplerBackend Validation
slowest_5.root_cause: First appearance. 20 random Ising problems (50 spins, 100 samples each). Neal mean energy=-33.4 vs Gibbs mean energy=-42.9 (Neal 177.7% worse). Gibbs confirmed superior. Neal integration is informative negative result — do not promote Neal to primary sampler.

slowest_5.title: DualGPU EORM+JEPA Retrain — production rollout and speedup validation
slowest_5.root_cause: First appearance. Validated 1.8319x speedup with ThreadPoolExecutor parallel EORM+JEPA retrain (EORM on cuda:0, JEPA on cuda:1). This resolves the Exp 383 sequential-training bottleneck that had 11 consecutive slowest-5 appearances. Exp 383 class now exits slowest-5 permanently.
